relevance_note: Table 1 lists a LAMP-2 mutation for the proband of each of 19 Japanese families, e.g. '| 1 | E9b | c.1097_1098 delAA | Frame shift | proband, 1 cousin |'.
method_note: Nationwide questionnaire survey; individual-level information is mainly Table 1 (one row per family: mutation, effect on mRNA, affected males, affected females, references). A script in my scratch directory transcribed Table 1 from the paper file; I checked the 20 rows, the person counts (39 = 17 males + 22 females, matching the text) and every span by eye and by a verbatim check. Labels: the paper has no per-person labels; Table 1 writes 'proband' in each family's row, so I used '<label> (Family <n>)' -> 'proband (Family n)', and relatives as '<relation> of proband (Family n)' from the Affected Males/Females cells ('1 cousin', 'mother', '1 aunt', '1 sister', '2 sisters' -> 'sister of ... ' and 'sister of ... 2'). Sex is from the column (Affected Males / Affected Females). family_label_in_paper is written 'Family n' as in the text; the span is the Table 1 'Family' cell. Variant rows only for the probands of the 19 families with a printed mutation (the paper ties the mutation to the probands; relatives' carrier status is not stated). Family 17 proband has no variant row (mutation NA; diagnosis from absent muscle LAMP-2). variant_type from the 'Effect on mRNA' column: 'Frame shift' -> frameshift, 'Splicing' -> splice, 'Stop codon' -> nonsense (also for c.741+1G>A, c.288_289 delAG and c.371_372 delCA, as printed). Variant strings kept as printed, including spaces ('c.440 T > A'). Zygosity left not reported: 'X chromosomes were heterozygous in all 19 families' is unclear for male probands. Inheritance not reported for all: the four female probands are said to have de novo mutations but parental testing of both parents is not described; for Families 6 and 12 the mothers had no LAMP-2 mutation (identified via refs [10,16] and 'probands' siblings were also affected'; germline mosaicism suggested). Group statements used: 'All 17 male patients had cardiomyopathy', 'Myopathy ... observed in all male patients' (skeletal myopathy checklist item for all 17 males), 'All male and female patients remained ambulatory' (loss of ambulation excluded for all 39), and 'The two affected males in Family 1 had hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and mild myopathy, but no mental retardation' (Family 1 proband and cousin; HCM read as left ventricular hypertrophy; 'no mental retardation' not used to exclude the broader cognitive checklist item). Proband (Family 19): onset at six years and severe cardiac failure, linked through the citation [22], which Table 1 gives only for Family 19 (a single female proband). Not assigned (ambiguous person): the 50-year-old man in Family 1 (proband or cousin); the heart-transplant / LVAD woman cited [17] (Family 14 mother or Family 20 proband); the female with no cardiac involvement and her monozygotic twin [13] (Family 9 sisters/mother); the young-onset stroke patient [19]; retinopathy, mental retardation, WPW, CK and death counts given only as numbers; 'LAMP-2 was completely absent in muscle from all male patients' / AVSF in 'all male patients' (likely only biopsied patients); reference-list titles not used. Contradictions in the paper: the text says Families 11 and 15 share c.877C > T, but Table 1 gives c.877 C>T for Family 10 and c.877C>T for Family 14 (rows follow Table 1); the text calls the Family 5 mutation an 'exon 6 skipping mutation' while Table 1 gives I5 c.742-4_742+6 delGAAGGTTGCT; Family 15 c.56T>C is labelled 'Frame shift'; 'LAMP-2 was completely absent in muscle from all male patients' vs 'the proband in Family 1 revealed a small amount of LAMP-2 protein'; abstract 'All patients had cardiomyopathy' vs one female with no cardiac involvement (so no cardiomyopathy rows for females). n_patients_reported is the 39 patients with Danon disease; LAMP-2 mutations are reported only for the 19 probands.
